parameters.description: name of input SD dataset

parameters.description: name of data column to be used ["data", "float_data", or "corrected"]

parameters.name: scan

parameters.name: minwidth

parameters.name: edge

parameters.name: blmode

parameters.description: subtract baseline from input data [True, False]
parameters.name: dosubtract

parameters.description: format(s) of file(s) in which best-fit parameters are written ["text", "csv", "table" or ""]

parameters.name: bloutput

parameters.name: bltable

parameters.name: order

parameters.name: npiece

parameters.description: automatically set wave numbers of sinusoids
parameters.name: applyfft

parameters.description: method for automatically set wave numbers of sinusoids
parameters.name: fftmethod

parameters.description: threshold to select wave numbers of sinusoids

parameters.name: clipniter

parameters.name: verbose

parameters.name: sigmavalue

parameters.name: minnrow

parameters.name: outfile
